notes.toyota_health: Toyota archive rate ~6.2%, all duplicates. Cleaner than GM family but not as clean as Volvo. Duplicate pattern: same real Toyota issue written under 2 slug variants (often with vs. without the descriptive suffix like '-failure' or '-leak').

Prius head gasket (2004-2009 vs 2004-2015 — same 1NZ-FXE issue)
Prius EGR cooler/valve (2010-2018 vs 2010-2020 — same EGR clogging)
Sienna sliding door (2004-2016 vs 2004-2020 — same power door issue)
Celica 2ZZ lift bolt (two entries for same GT-S 2ZZ-GE issue)
Paseo clutch cable (two entries for same issue)
